text_block_list.text: Thank you for the day off.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I did. I went for a nice, long run in a
place I had
been meaning to visit for a
long while.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That might also be why my legs feel so
light
today.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It seems Сайленс Судзука has managed to

adequately refresh both her body and
mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
